page_title: INT 1-0 VEN | Inter v Venezia 03/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' That's the end of the match.
90+10' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Venezia due to a handball in the build-up play.
90+9' Wait! Referee Maria Caputi has indicated he is going to review the Venezia goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a handball in the build-up.
90+8' The main referee, Maria Caputi, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Davide Frattesi (Inter) is given a yellow card for dissent.
90+8' Goal! Marin Sverko (Venezia) finds some space in the penalty area after latching onto a cross and finds the back of the net with a sweet header!
90+7' Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Venezia) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
90+5' John Yeboah (Venezia) picks up the rebound after chaos in the box and directs a sweet strike towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper, however, makes a stunning save.
90+3' A lofted cross from Gianluca Busio (Venezia) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
90+2' Alfred Duncan (Venezia) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.

90' Stefan de Vrij (Inter) times his run into the box perfectly and slams a header goalwards from the centre of the box, but it lacks accuracy and flies well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Venezia will have a goal kick.
90' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) prepares to take a corner kick.
89' Inter have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
88' The corner kick from Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

88' Filip Stankovic makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) on the edge of the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of inside the left post. The ball goes behind for a corner. Inter will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
87' Ridgeciano Haps (Venezia) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
86' Venezia take a short corner kick.
86' John Yeboah (Venezia) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Venezia force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
86' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) connects with the free kick and produces a header goalwards which is well blocked. The goalkeeper doesn't have to worry about that one.
85' Maria Caputi has a clear sight and sees a foul from John Yeboah (Venezia). Inter will take a free kick near the side line.
84' Simone Inzaghi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Davide Frattesi (Inter) replacing Piotr Zielinski.
83' Substitution. John Yeboah (Venezia) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Hans Nicolussi Caviglia walks off.
82' Jay Idzes (Venezia) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball has crossed the sideline. Venezia are taking a throw-in.
81' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY to Inter, play can continue.
80' There's a break in play and referee Maria Caputi must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Inter using VAR. This could be interesting!

79' Marcus Thuram (Inter) escapes his marker to connect with a cross and heads towards the top of the net, but the keeper pulls off an excellent save to deny him. The ball is out of play and Inter manage to earn a corner.
78' The possession of the ball – 62:38.
77' The substitution is prepared. Alfred Duncan (Venezia) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Magnus Kofod Andersen.
77' Substitution. Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Venezia) on for Francesco Zampano.
76' Simone Inzaghi has decided to make a change. Matteo Darmian (Inter) replaces Federico Dimarco.
73' Inter seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
71' Venezia couldn't find the way to score from a close-range free kick as Yann Sommer (Inter) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
71' Substitution. Lautaro Martinez makes way for Mehdi Taremi (Inter).
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Yann Bisseck replaces Alessandro Bastoni (Inter).
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) comes onto the pitch for Nicolo Barella.
69' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
68' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Maria Caputi blows for a foul. A free kick to Venezia.

67' Filip Stankovic was forced into action to thwart Marcus Thuram (Inter). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom right corner but couldn't beat the keeper.
67' Francesco Zampano (Venezia) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.

65' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Lautaro Martinez (Inter) bursts into the box to get on the end of a whipped in cross from Federico Dimarco and scores magnificently from close range low into the middle of the goal. 1:0.
64' Francesco Zampano (Venezia) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
63' Federico Dimarco (Inter) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
63' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) commits a foul and Maria Caputi immediately signals a free kick.
62' Federico Dimarco (Inter) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
61' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) wins a header inside the box after a cross and steers it goalwards, but Filip Stankovic produces a wonderful reflex save. The ball is out of play. Inter win a corner kick.
60' Marcus Thuram (Inter) goes on a mazy run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his low effort to the middle of the target is thwarted by Filip Stankovic.
58' Francesco Zampano (Venezia) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
58' Francesco Zampano (Venezia) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
57' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) strikes the rebound, but it goes well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Venezia.
56' Joel Pohjanpalo (Venezia) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Inter will have a goal kick.
54' The corner is swung in but Venezia can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

54' Joel Pohjanpalo (Venezia) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the middle of the goal. Yann Sommer is alert, though, and makes an easy save to deny him.
53' The goal by Inter is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
53' The Inter players halt their celebrations as referee Maria Caputi makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.

51' Goal! Federico Dimarco plays in Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter), who shows great determination to get to the ball before a couple of defenders and from inside the box he shoots into the top right corner of the net! Great finish - 1:0.

50' Piotr Zielinski (Inter) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
49' What was Francesco Zampano (Venezia) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
49' Francesco Zampano (Venezia) is penalised for holding. Maria Caputi signals a set piece. Inter have a free kick.
48' Federico Dimarco (Inter) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
47' An attempted cross from Denzel Dumfries (Inter) is cleared. Inter earn a corner.
47' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Substitution. Giorgio Altare is replaced by Marin Sverko (Venezia).
46' Here is a change. Domen Crnigoj is going off and Eusebio Di Francesco gives the last tactical orders to Gianluca Busio (Venezia).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
43' The percentage of ball possession is – 62:38.
41' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) latches onto a cross and shoots from close-range, but Yann Sommer makes a terrific save to deny him.
40' Federico Dimarco (Inter) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
38' Piotr Zielinski (Inter) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
37' Good defending. Federico Dimarco (Inter) tries to find Lautaro Martinez inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
36' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Venezia, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
36' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) commits a rough challenge and Maria Caputi blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Venezia.
35' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the middle of the goal was easily saved by Filip Stankovic.
34' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.
33' Marcus Thuram (Inter) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Venezia.
32' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Venezia, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
31' Benjamin Pavard (Inter) has tested the patience of referee Maria Caputi and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
28' Marcus Thuram (Inter) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.

27' Venezia slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
24' Federico Dimarco (Inter) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
24' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. Inter win a corner.

22' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Inter are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
20' Jay Idzes (Venezia) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Inter.
19' Maria Caputi blows his whistle and it's Marcus Thuram (Inter) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
19' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.

17' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Venezia will have a goal kick.
15' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) is penalised for a foul. Maria Caputi had a clear view and blows his whistle.
14' The resulting corner from Federico Dimarco (Inter) is cleared by the defence.

13' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball is behind the touchline and Venezia will take a throw-in.
12' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) tries to find Federico Dimarco with a clever through ball from the corner of the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
11' The ball is cleared after Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
9' Federico Dimarco (Inter) launches a cross from the corner, but Filip Stankovic is alert to thwart the effort.
8' Nicolo Barella (Inter) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Inter.
6' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Venezia.
5' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Inter, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

4' Francesco Zampano (Venezia) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee. Inter are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
4' The foul by Benjamin Pavard (Inter) was seen by Maria Caputi who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
3' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
2' Nicolo Barella (Inter) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Venezia will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Maria Caputi.
Show lineups Both teams starting lineups are available now, so you can have a look at them.
